'''Chris Giles''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[June 2000 Sacramento tournament]] on 10 June 2000 with [[This Deal Is Getting Worse All The Time / Pray I Don't Alter It Any Further|Dark Deal]], according to Clayton Atkin's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d871">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-sacramento-ca-6-10-00d871/ sacramento-ca-6-10-00], DeckTech (Clayton "TheDohMan" Atkin, 11 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-11-sacramento-ca-6-10-00d871/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
